settingsMenu.triggerTitle: Adjust screen, language, workspace, and AI agent connection in one place
settingsMenu.title: Settings
settingsMenu.viewModeCaption: General: folds code elements and uses plain language
settingsMenu.canvasBgCaption: Pick the map's background texture: it always stays fainter than nodes and links
settingsMenu.glyphSetCaption: Pick the node icon style: the shapes (kinds) never change
settingsMenu.arrangementCaption: Pick what decides where nodes sit in the 3D map. Ownership stacks the containment tree in layers; coupling pulls closely related nodes near each other
settingsMenu.accentCaption: Pick the app's single colour. The app icon is baked at install time, so it stays as it is
settingsMenu.workspaceFolderErrorFallback: Couldn't read the folder: pick it again
settingsMenu.workspaceFolderErrorPathMissing: That folder is gone. It looks like it was moved or deleted. Pick it again.
settingsMenu.workspaceFolderErrorPermissionDenied: Your Mac is not letting this app read that folder. Allow it in System Settings, or pick a folder somewhere else.
settingsMenu.workspaceFolderErrorRootRejected: That location cannot hold a folder. Pick a project folder instead.
settingsMenu.vaultBodyLocal: Open Ontology documents to review the files and concepts in your folder
settingsMenu.vaultBodyStatic: Pick a writable folder in the desktop app or the local workspace flow
settingsMenu.agentNoVaultHint: Open the folder your ontology lives in, and the connection files can be checked and repaired here.
settingsMenu.agentTerminalBody: These two lines make a vault and write a .mcp.json and a .codex/config.toml that point Claude Code, Cursor and Codex at that folder. They run on your machine and nothing leaves it.
settingsMenu.cliPlaceholderHint: Set this once in your terminal: export ATLAS="path to your ontology-atlas source folder". There is no npm package.
settingsMenu.mcpProofTitle: Check that the connection really works
settingsMenu.mcpProofBody: This screen alone cannot promise the connection. When Codex or Claude shows this server, copy the first question below and paste it to see whether the agent answers with a concept from this folder.

affordanceHint.pill: Sits in open space away from the node, joined by a dotted line. The only one of the three that has to find a spot: as space runs out it drifts further away.
affordanceHint.bar: A row of text buttons directly above the selected node. Nothing shows until you select, and it says in numbers how many will open.
affordanceHint.badge: A small circle docked on the node's upper-left shoulder. It travels with the node so it never has to find a spot; hover tells you what it will do.

structureHint.disc: What the map drew before. A golden-angle spiral, so the area it takes grows only with the square root of the child count.
structureHint.fan: What the map draws today. An arc sweeping outward, so names line up side by side. It widens as rows stack up.
structureHint.ring: A ring wrapped around the parent. It uses every direction, so the same count fits in less area.
structureHint.column: Children lined up outward. Names sit side by side and read most easily, but the layout gets long.

expand.batchHint: The rest wait behind another “open N more”. The smaller this is, the more room names have to land.
expand.labelAttemptsHint: Per parent. The most important ones are tried first, and a name with no room is dropped. So this is not “how many get a name” but “how many are attempted”.
expand.maxOpenHint: Open one more than this and the parent open longest closes. Better than a click that does nothing.

sectionPurpose.screen: Language, view mode, icons and accent colour. They apply to every screen.
sectionPurpose.background: Choose what lies behind the map. The map shows it right away.
sectionPurpose.expand: Choose how collapsed groups open on the map. Changes apply to the map right away.
sectionPurpose.footprint: A star lights on every concept you open, numbered in the order you walked them, with light running along each line the way you went.
sectionPurpose.notify: Choose what the app shows and tells you while an agent works.
sectionPurpose.workspace: The folder you opened and what it holds.
sectionPurpose.update: When a new build of this app ships, a notice in the bottom-right corner tells you.

settingsMenu.guideAutoStartCaption: Opens by itself the first time you visit each screen. Turned off, it opens only from Show again or the guide icon at the map's top right
settingsMenu.frameMeterCaption: Shows frames per second and the worst stall on the map. Off by default: nothing is measured while it is off.
settingsMenu.agentStatusCaption: Shows “Working” and the time of the last write on the map while an agent or a person edits this folder. On by default.
settingsMenu.agentNotificationsCaption: Announces when a task starts and ends, and when a domain appears or disappears. Single nodes and single relations are not announced: the map already shows them.
settingsMenu.agentNotificationKindsCaption: Muted kinds never reach the bell.

runtimes.intro: Atlas finds the AI coding tools installed on this computer. Only a tool confirmed to ask before writing opens the chat beside the map; the rest can still be used for the agent connection (MCP) setup.
runtimes.mcpLink: Share this folder with a tool you run yourself, or attach a connector, in the MCP section below (the agent connection)
runtimes.heading: Tools on this computer
runtimes.noneReadyCaption: Install Claude Agent or Codex and they show up here. The install guides are in the list below.
runtimes.noneReadyCaptionNoList: Install Claude Agent or Codex and they show up here. Press “Check again” after installing.
runtimes.webLabel: A browser is not allowed to start programs on this computer
runtimes.webCaption: Pointing a tool you started yourself at this folder works right now, in the “Share this folder” section on the MCP tab.
runtimes.guardedExplainer: In-app chat opens only with {names} for now. The other tools are for connection setup only.
runtimes.guardedExplainerNone: No tool can open an in-app chat yet. Detected tools can still be used for connection setup.
runtimes.unknownExplainer: "Could not check" does not mean the tool is absent; it means Atlas does not yet know how to find it on this computer. You can follow the install guide or connect over MCP, but the in-app chat opens only with a tool confirmed to ask before writing.
runtimes.openChat: Open a chat with this tool
runtimes.loginHint: Run it once in a terminal to sign in, then it is ready.
runtimes.loginUnknownHint: Atlas asked this tool whether you are signed in and got no answer back. The tool is still here, so a chat opens; if it turns you away, sign in once in a terminal.
runtimes.diskNote: Starting a chat gives Atlas its own settings folder for that tool inside the app, so your own settings for it are left alone. The login you already did is linked, not copied, so you do not have to sign in again. The original stays in one place.
runtimes.unknownShelfNote: Atlas does not yet know how to find these on this computer, so even an installed one cannot open an in-app chat. They still work over the MCP connection.
runtimes.webToolsHeading: {count} coding tools the desktop app looks for
runtimes.othersSearchPlaceholder: A name, or what it is

appUpdate.versionUnknown: Could not read the version. Checking for updates reads it again.
appUpdate.autoLast: Checks once a day when the app opens. Last checked {when}.
appUpdate.autoNever: Checks once a day when the app opens. It has not checked on this computer yet.
appUpdate.autoDismissed: You put {version} off with Later; Check for updates shows it again.
appUpdate.resultCurrent: You're on the newest build. Nothing to fetch.
appUpdate.resultAvailable: {version} is out. Grab it from the bottom-right notice.
appUpdate.resultDownloading: Fetching {version}. Progress is in the bottom-right notice.
appUpdate.resultReady: {version} is installed. Restart from the bottom-right notice to use it.
appUpdate.resultFailed: Couldn't fetch the update information. Check your connection, then try again.
appUpdate.resultInstallFailed: The update could not finish installing. Try again in a moment.
